positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented code for classifying users that visit the MSN homepage into groups in order to serve content that is more relevant to their individual interests.
Developed tools for monitoring MSN's internal content optimization tools.
Used Silverlight for graphical interface and REST and SOAP for inter-service communication

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
positions.description:
Automated through C# the generation of traceability matrix results between requirement and test case documents
Consolidated design goals from Bsquare's client in order to implement custom project features
Resulted in much tighter validation of client's project requirements

Wrote test cases to ensure proper functionality of USB and Wireless media player for Ford SYNC device.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Managed and configured the MSN Platform team's build server
Wrote various C# tools to integrate with and enhance the MSBuild/Team Foundation Server build and source control system
Helped integrate the new build system with internal content management systems, specifically aiding modularity of design
Rewrote existing CSS-crunching utility to use an abstract syntax tree for improved flexibility and extensibility

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Wrote a tool to compile all necessary JavaScript into a single file for a given web page

Designed and built an application for monitoring MSN sites for stale and missing content
Implemented an ASP.NET page for displaying a monthly content performance summary

Wrote a back-end program to automatically supply MSN users with relevant local weather, news, and city guides, based upon their IP address
Implemented SQL database solution for data storage
